translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Ohala miyudo kuom bedo gi rieko

content.text: Yawuota, winjuru puonj mag wuonu;
chikuru itu eka ubed gi ngʼeyo moloyo.
Puonj mara mamiyou beyo,
omiyo kik ujwangʼ puonjna.
Kane pod an wuowi e od wuora,
kane pod an rawera kendo nyathi achiel kende mar minwa,
nopuonja kowacho niya,
“Mak matek wechena gi chunyi duto,
rit chikena eka inibed mangima.
Yud rieko kod ngʼeyo matut,
wiyi kik wil kod wechena kata weyogi.
Kik ijwangʼ rieko to obiro bedoni ragengʼ;
here, to obiro ritoi.
Rieko nigi duongʼ moloyo, omiyo yud rieko.
Kata obedo ni mwanduni duto nyalo rumo,
to bed gi winjo tiend wach.
Miye duongʼ, to enotingʼi malo;
rwake chutho, to obiro miyi duongʼ.
Enoket ogut ngʼwono e wiyi
kendo nosidhni osimbo mar duongʼ.”
Wuoda, winji kendo yie gima awacho
eka higni mag ngimani nobed mangʼeny.
Apuonji e yor rieko
kendo anyisi yo makare.
Ka iwuotho, to ok inikier
bende ka iringo, to ok inichwanyri.
Mak motegno gima isepuonjori,
kik iweye, olalni to irite maber, nikech en e ngimani.
Kik iwuothi e yor joma timbegi mono
kata kik iluw yor jomaricho.
Bed mabor gi yorno, kik iwuothie,
to wichri kendo iluw yori iwuon.
Nikech ok ginyal nindo nyaka gitim gima mono;
ayula wangʼ bende ok nyal terogi kapok gimiyo ngʼato opodho.
Timbe mamono e chiembgi ma gichamo,
to timbe ja-mahundu e divai ma gimadho.
Yor joma kare chalo ka ugwe mar kogwen,
omedo rieny maler nyaka chiengʼ wuogi.
To yor joricho chalo gi mudho mandiwa;
ok gingʼeyo gima miyo gichwanyore.
Wuoda, chik iti malongʼo ne gima awacho,
chik iti maber ne wechena.
Kik iwe gilal e wangʼi
to kan-gi e chunyi;
nikech gikelo ngima ni jogo moyudogo
kendo gin gi ngima maber ne ringre dhano duto.
To moloyo duto, rit chunyi,
nikech en e soko mar ngima.
Wach ma ok adiera kik aa e dhogi;
weche mag miganga kik wuogi e dhogi.
Rang mana nyimi tir,
ka ichomo wangʼi moriere tir e nyimi.
Rie yore tir monego iluw
kendo luw mana yore motegno.
Kik ibar kidhiyo korachwich kata koracham;
rit tiendi mondo kik idonji e richo.
